sentences.text: The noon-only plan was changed because rain disrupted the noon visit, leading to the adoption of morning and noon observations.
sentences.quote:
Use morning and noon observations after rain disrupted the noon visit. This replaces the noon-only plan; better sampling accuracy has not been measured.
2024-05-19T11:00:00Z Rain interrupts the noon visit.
2024-05-20T08:00:00Z Maya adopts morning and noon observations.

sentences.text: Better accuracy was not established when the plan changed from noon-only to morning and noon sampling.
sentences.quote:
Better sampling accuracy has not been measured.
No accuracy comparison was run.
